summary: The Acer Predator Helios 16 (PH16-71) and Helios Neo 16 (PHN16-71) laptops are experiencing a random black screen issue, accompanied by Event 153 (nvlddmkm.sys), after recent BIOS updates. The problem affects both models with identical behavior, despite different GPU configurations.
detected_fault: A faulty NVIDIA driver or corrupted system files may be causing the display driver reset event (Event ID 153 - nvlddmkm.sys).
suggested_solution: Reinstalling the latest NVIDIA drivers and verifying BIOS/EC versions match could resolve the issue.
